segs.utf8: Let me just start with an example
a neuron is a thing that holds a number
between zero and one and we call that its activation
the input layer is the image itself
seven hundred and eighty four pixels flattened out
weights decide which pattern a neuron looks for
and the bias decides how much evidence it needs
in matrix notation this collapses to one line
thirteen thousand and two knobs in total
and learning just means turning them
